title: An open immersion of schemes is etale
statement: Let $j:U\to X$ be an open immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-open-immersion]. Then $j$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. In particular, for every open subscheme $U\subseteq X$ the inclusion $U\hookrightarrow X$ is an object of the small etale site $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and for opens $W\subseteq U\subseteq X$ the inclusion $W\hookrightarrow U$ is a morphism of $X_{\Et}$.
